verdicts.method: read both page images by eye; the saved text layer's heading; grep of the registers and narrative.js
verdicts.evidence: Page image p. 262: 'Не нахожу, как бы оправдать его ... А притом генерал-майора графа Каменского 1-го с полком его и другими рассеянными несколькими командами послав назад, тем храброго сего генерала с его отрядом подвергал крайней опасности' (the subject Langeron, named above: 'Не должно ли приписать в вину графа Ланжерона'). p. 261: the answer to Kutuzov's letter 'сего января от 16', the writer the 1st Column's commander. Text layer: '№ 250 / 1806 г. января 21. — ПИСЬМО Ф. Ф. БУКСГЕВДЕНА М. И. КУТУЗОВУ ... Дубно'. Registers: kutuzov1951 readings are pp. 226, 230, 241-242, 255-258, 265, 266-267, 269-270; none of pp. 260-262. narrative.js:182-186: the 'Langeron sent the brigade' side is Schönhals p. 161 alone.
verdicts.notes: Buxhowden commanded the 1st Column at Telnitz, so his letter is second-hand for the plateau and partisan (it blames Langeron): it weights the side, it does not settle the dispute. S4 P3 unresolved-historical, inherited, agreed.

verdicts.method: read the Schönhals page image by eye; the register's C1.20 and C2.18; data.js:80, :569-571; analysis.js:292-294; narrative.js:42-44; archive builds
verdicts.evidence: Page image p. 162: 'Kutusow befahl den österreichischen Brigaden Jurschek und Rottermund, die Höhe zu nehmen.' Those brigades are the IV Column's Austrian wing (data.js:569-571 kollo 'Austrian wing, IV Column', 'Brigades: Jurczek · Rottermund'). The project registered this sentence (readings.md:292-302, C1.20, grade B, fact) and Stutterheim's 'Der General Kollowrath erhielt Befehl, den Feind auf dem linken Flügel aufzuhalten' (readings.md:801-808, C2.18, grade A), yet data.js:80 says 'in this map's reading, which no account read gives' and narrative.js:42 classes the why 'interpretation' citing only Mikhailovsky-Danilevsky and Kutuzov's two relations. Wording unchanged since step 5c (archive/step5c-45f8f662.html), claim 'fact' since Stage 0.
verdicts.notes: Schönhals alone contradicts 'no account read gives' an order by Kutuzov to the 4th Column. Stutterheim pp. 63-64 gives the Emperor's order to the Russian battalions and an unnamed order to Kollowrath: a competing side on who ordered, not a contradiction of 'no account gives Kutuzov's order' (the title's 'and by Stutterheim' is slightly overstated). Related to history #2, whose remedy ('recon') it changes to 'disputed' with sides; not a duplicate. S3 P2 inherited agreed.
